notes.title: Devlog 1: Spark Ignited — Welcome to the Shattered Realms
notes.content:
[b]«Why make a game? Because I craved something brutally honest: a dark fantasy where every sword swing could be your last. Wishlist LOST REALMS and join my descent into madness.»[/b]  

[h2]☠️ Who Am I & Why Should You Care?[/h2]  
Let’s get this straight: I’m not a studio. I’m a guy who spent 2000+ hours in games like [i]Darkest Dungeon[/i] and [i]Escape from Tarkov[/i], screaming at the screen: “What if we combined THIS with THAT?!”.  

This is [b]LOST REALMS[/b] — my love letter to:  
[list]  
[*] The despair of permadeath (RIP, [i]Stoneshard[/i] characters).  
[*] The adrenaline of extraction shooters (but with swords, because guns are for cowards).  
[*] Gothic architecture that makes you want to redecorate… in blood.  
[/list]  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45537038/b308520ce0a4b4bb7010fa4b7163623f85d57fb8.png[/img]
[h2]🌑 The Pitch: “Dark Fantasy That Punishes Like a Jilted Lover”[/h2]  
[i]Imagine:[/i]  
You wake up on a floating island. The sky? Shattered. The gods? Rotting. Your mission? Scavenge ruins, fight horrors, and [i]maybe[/i] make it back to your Sanctuary alive.  

[list]  
[*] [b]Death is a Tax Collector[/b] — Lose everything but your grit (and trauma).  
[*] [b]Your Sanctuary is Your Soul[/b] — Rebuild it; unlock hybrid classes (Rogue-Mage-Necromancer? Go nuts).  
[*] [b]NPCs Will Betray You[/b] — That cheerful blacksmith? He’s 73% Redditor.  
[/list]  

[h2]🔍 Peeking Behind the Curtain: What’s Done?[/h2]  
[b]The World:[/b]  
[list]  
[*] [b]Veiled Woods[/b] — A forest so dense, even the shadows get lost.  
[*] [b]Drowned Citadel[/b] — Think "Atlantis meets Silent Hill" with ✨godrays✨.  
[*] [b]Ashen Wastes[/b] — Where sandstorms erase bones… and your progress.  
[/list]  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45537038/c1705a0ed43f134f491ce0584953a495ccfa25e0.png[/img]
[b]The Combat:[/b]  
[list]  
[*] [b]Weight Matters[/b] — Daggers = fast but weak, Greatswords = slow but [i]"Oh gods, my spine!"[/i].  
[*] [b]Ranged Combat = Self-Harm[/b] — Powerful Shot? 100% eaten by wolves (balance!).  
[/list]  

[b]Enemies (So Far):[/b]  
[list]  
[*] Skeletons that are made of bones. Yes, really. 
[*] Wolves (awoooo)
[*] Spiders
[*] Ghoul
[*] [b]The Warden of Roots[/b] — Feather-covered Menace (weakness: [i]poetry readings[/i]).  
[/list]  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45537038/c0298d177648bd1a4c4eb0b6946a90595f252719.png[/img]
[h2]🚧 Current State of the Madness[/h2]  
[list]  
[*] [b]Demo Target:[/b] soon (soon enough) (Pray for me).  
[*] [b]Progress:[/b] 65% — Core combat works, 2/3 zones modeled, 1 boss that haunts my dreams.  
[*] [b]Mod Support Planned[/b] — Replace spiders with cupcakes? You do you.  
[/list]  

[h2]🤔 Community Corner: Let’s Get Controversial[/h2]  
[b]Question 1:[/b] What’s worse than losing all loot on death?  
[list]  
[*] A) Your character develops PTSD and refuses to leave the Sanctuary.  
[*] B) Enemies steal your gear and mock you in broken English.  
[/list]  

[b]Question 2:[/b] What creature should we add next?  
[list]  
[*] A) A mimic that pretends to be an exit portal.  
[*] B) Pablo.  
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45537038/24d137bed4729dde580c8929b3430271be27c5b2.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45537038/ff30f2b5dfb7b078a4654011f721b12327797ce3.png[/img][/url]
[/list]  
[i]Comment your war crimes below.[/i]  

[h2]🔮 Why Wishlist?[/h2]  
Because this isn’t just a game — it’s a [b]test[/b]. Will you cling to hope? Or let the Shattered Realms break you?  

[b]👉 WISHLIST LOST REALMS ON STEAM[/b]

[i]P.S. Follow for Devlog #2: “Why I Regret Adding Permadeath” (and cat pics from crunch time).[/i]
